protocol.extent: Search 8-, 12-, 16- and 20-picture cores inside one verified shot. Both five-picture flanks and the core need at least 60% measured entries per horizon. Use minimum excess over the two flanks, then require both horizons to support a positive excess. Keep the strongest interval, with exact before, middle and first-after source frames/crops.
protocol.gate: At least four strict LivePortrait locations across three groups and the strict independent MuseTalk location, at least 70% measurement coverage on each main class, at most two ordinary alerts, none on untouched, hard-cut or recompressed deliveries. One strict MuseTalk case is descriptive, not a stable rate across generators.
protocol.ordinary_derivatives: Six fresh speaker groups outside MuseTalk holdout. Add two 16-picture ordinary crop controls per group using fixed same-time subpixel resampling and a same-time local two-picture temporal blend with unchanged outer pixels. Encode native RGB losslessly, preserve presentation times, and keep all derived files in held only.
protocol.point: Third-largest ordinary GRID development maximum per arm, with fixed floors 0.08 and 0.10 respectively, and strict exceedance. A useful location uses native half-open interval IoU >= 0.50.
protocol.signal: Compare local point track survival and position disagreement between direct and adjacent routes over 3 and 4 native pictures. Rigid eye normalization, seed points from tracked mouth and cheek regions, match normalized corner strength and reject globally unreliable comparisons. No pixel-energy evidence, audio, earlier copy, source timing markers or rendered support enters measurement.
protocol.tracks: Greedy one-to-one matching of strongest mouth corners to cheek corners within a 4x strength ratio. Require three matched starts. Track with 9-pixel Lucas–Kanade, one pyramid level, and a fixed 1.25-pixel direct round-trip tolerance. Cycle arm includes pairs with all routes valid; adjacent chains and direct paths are independently computed.
